Message:
How strange.
My body’s lighter,
and power is surging through me.

This must be a new power—
one that Fortina and I
seized together.

In this very moment,
I know there’s no foe
who can defeat us.
“Haaaaaaaaaah!!”

First, I pierce through
the creature in front of me.

Before it can even fall,
I spring backwards and
rush the next prey,

then strike to the left!
And after that...!
“It ends here!”

I impale the last creature standing,
and the lifeless cursed creatures
vanish like lifting fog.

“I knew you could do it, Florence.
But, to think that you can
take them down all on your own.”

Fortina stood beside me,
smiling as gently as ever.

“No, I couldn’t have
done it on my own.
I won this fight because
you were with me, Fortina.”

It was then that
the setting sun cast its glow,
and our eyes found each other.

Ah... The time for
our promise has come...

“The sunset is
so beautiful, Florence.”

Fortina smiled gently,
her eyes glowing
in the hues of the sunset.

“Listen, Florence.
This time, let me be
the one who vows to you.

Even if the day comes when
we must part ways,
I will never stop believing in you.

So please, always keep
my heart close to yours.”

“Thank you, Fortina.
For believing in
someone like me...

This time, I’ll prove that
I’m worthy of your trust.
That’s why...”

Our bond is unbreakable.
Much stronger than
any promise, and any vow.

Now, no one can ever
tear us apart.

“I vow to always protect you.
As your knight.”
